issue.title: Primary main keeps diverging: plan-artifact push lands on origin but local main can't follow (untracked .pan files block reset --keep)
acceptanceCriteria: Given origin already holds a patch-equivalent copy of local commit X and local has a new commit Y, when pushPlanArtifacts runs, then origin gains exactly one commit, that commit touches at least one file, and home HEAD equals origin main

Given every local commit already landed on origin, when pushPlanArtifacts runs, then it returns pushed:false, skipped:true with a reason containing 'already on', origin main is unchanged, and home HEAD equals origin main
Given local main holds a merge commit over origin, when pushPlanArtifacts runs, then it returns pushed:false, skipped:false with a reason containing 'merge commits', and origin main is unchanged
Given origin has not moved since the last fetch, when pushPlanArtifacts runs with one local .pan/ commit, then it pushes that commit unchanged and returns rebased:false with sha equal to local HEAD

Given origin gained .pan/continues/X.json through a merge and the plan home holds an identical untracked copy, when a sequence commit is pushed, then home HEAD equals origin main, X.json is tracked and clean with origin's content, and no backup file remains

Given the untracked copy differs from origin's, when the push follows, then home HEAD equals origin main, the result's backedUp lists path '.pan/continues/X.json' with a backup file containing the local bytes, and git status --porcelain shows no plan-artifact-backups entry

Given an identical untracked collision plus a tracked .pan/ file whose local modification makes reset --keep refuse, when the push runs, then the result carries a warning containing 'could not move', the untracked file is restored at its original path with its original content, and home HEAD is unchanged
Given a non-colliding untracked .pan/backlog/draft.md, when the push replays onto a moved origin, then the file remains untracked at its path with unchanged content

describePlanArtifactPush returns null for a clean push and for a plain skip, returns the warning text for a pushed-with-warning result, and lists each backup as 'path -> backup' in details when backedUp is set

surfacePlanArtifactPush emits exactly one activity entry with source 'plan-artifacts', level 'warn', and an id matching /^plan-artifact-push:[0-9a-f]{12}$/ for a problem result, and emits nothing for a clean push
Both CLI callers route through surfacePlanArtifactPush: `grep -n "push.pushed ? push.warning" src/cli/index.ts src/cli/commands/orders.ts` returns no matches
Given the target root is the workspace and the workspace holds .pan/drafts/PAN-4224.md, when promoteWorkspacePrdDraft runs, then it returns reason 'canonical-exists' and the file is still present

blocker.title: PRD readers still look only in the primary checkout, so newly planned issues lose their PRD on the dashboard and in the work-agent prompt
